parts.title: Establish the legal graph
parts.task: Enumerate every state pair and distinguish an illegal transition from an absent invoice.
acceptance: Every state pair matches the legal graph; missing resources and illegal moves are distinct.

parts.title: Apply legal lifecycle changes
parts.task: Repair API/service transitions while preserving customer, money and issued identity.
acceptance: Legal lifecycle transitions preserve money/customer identity; the complete invoice remains unchanged on rejection.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: The complete legal lifecycle must end in a terminal state whose rejected edit preserves every field.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Two users attempt different transitions from the same revision. Design a compare-and-set/version check and explain which loser receives a conflict without overwriting the winner.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

invoice-status-transition.invariant: Transition legality is a directed graph; rejected writes preserve the entire stored invoice.

parts.title: Establish ranked parity
parts.task: Capture score, popularity and id tie rules, normalized tokens, empty searches and exact limit behavior.
acceptance: Preserve score/popularity/id ordering, token normalization, empty output and prefix limits.

parts.title: Reduce measured work
parts.task: Repair the service path; compare ranked outputs and operation counts before interpreting latency.
acceptance: Ranked outputs agree; verify real work and record calibrated latency, retaining the declared manual review requirements.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A repeated query against changed data must reflect the new ranked winner and preserve prefix limits.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add indexed catalogue updates or a query cache. Define invalidation/version ownership and show a changed-product query that detects stale results; counters still require independent review.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

catalog-suggest-latency.invariant: An optimization may change work performed but must preserve the entire ranking and current data.

parts.title: Establish observable state
parts.task: Reproduce one mark and verify both stored read state and the rendered count, including already-read rows.
acceptance: Stored read state and rendered badge agree after one action, including an already-read row.

parts.title: Merge concurrent successes
parts.task: Repair two distinct and repeated quick actions without replacing another action’s update.
acceptance: Distinct and repeated concurrent successes converge without overwriting another action’s update.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A failed concurrent mark must not erase two successful independent updates.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: A refresh started before a mark completes afterward. Define request-generation or merge semantics and prove a stale response cannot undo a successful mark; discuss which server guarantees are needed.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

notification-feed-stale.invariant: Each async completion merges into current state and must converge with rendered rows and badge.

parts.title: Recover event identity
parts.task: Reproduce duplicate replay versus distinct same-status events and preserve deterministic timeline order.
acceptance: Distinct same-status events remain; an exact replay contributes once.

parts.title: Aggregate without leaked state
parts.task: Deduplicate before quantities, handle ties/negative deltas and replace totals on subsequent/empty merges.
acceptance: Quantities include negative deltas, isolate shipments and replace previous merge state, including empty input.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Adding unrelated records and a replayed event must not change an existing shipment total.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: The same event id arrives with different content. Define whether to reject, quarantine or explicitly version the correction; the present baseline only defines exact replays, so do not silently invent first-wins semantics.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

shipment-csv-merge.invariant: Event id identifies one contribution; status and shipment id do not.

parts.title: Identify scope and failures
parts.task: Distinguish missing authentication, missing resources and a resource outside the caller’s tenant without disclosing private content.
acceptance: No authentication yields 401; missing or out-of-scope resources yield 404 without private content.

parts.title: Apply policy end to end
parts.task: Keep authorized list/read/edit flows working in both tenants and preserve untouched document fields.
acceptance: Authorized reads/edits succeed in both tenants and leave unrelated fields and documents intact.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Denied foreign requests must not poison later authorized writes or unrelated data.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Introduce explicit cross-tenant sharing grants. Specify owner and recipient rights, revocation and default denial before extending lookup policy; a grant must not authorize unrelated documents.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

tenant-document-acl.invariant: Authorization scopes resource lookup and writes; hiding response fields is insufficient.

parts.title: Trace one delivery
parts.task: Reproduce a transient failure and separate one billing effect from multiple bounded HTTP attempts.
acceptance: One charge belongs to one delivery id; attempts never exceed policy, including exhaustion.

parts.title: Deliver a bounded batch
parts.task: Preserve per-input outcomes while capping active posts and handling exhausted retries.
acceptance: At most five posts are active; one outcome remains in each input position.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Duplicate delivery ids in one concurrent batch share billing identity but keep one result per job.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Persist idempotency across restarts and handle a receiver that commits before its reply is lost. Define the idempotency key/payload policy and identify what requires receiver cooperation before claiming exactly-once effects.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

webhook-delivery-retry.invariant: Billing identity belongs to a delivery; attempts and batch positions are separate identities.

manual_requirements: quote delegates to extracted applyRules; source review

parts.title: Preserve the map
parts.task: Reproduce the rendering defect and distinguish route marks from endpoint, badge and gate tiles.
acceptance: Endpoints and permission tiles survive rendering; malformed grids are rejected.

parts.title: Route with permissions
parts.task: Implement shortest legal traversal with deterministic neighbor ties, reusable badges and directed restrictions.
acceptance: Return the shortest legal route or None, with stated neighbor ties and reusable permission inventory.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A coordinate must be revisited with a different permission inventory.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Give floor cells different movement costs. Explain why FIFO BFS no longer guarantees minimum cost and how state identity, tie rules and the independent oracle change.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

warehouse-route-planner.invariant: Search state is position plus acquired permissions; display must preserve topology.

parts.title: Recover precise amounts
parts.task: Repair per-delivery half-up rounding using integer cents and reject invalid/conflicting records without mutation.
acceptance: Round each delivery half-up in integer cents; conflicting or invalid records preserve the ledger.

parts.title: Pay and measure activity
parts.task: Implement completed-delivery cutoff payments and clipped half-open distinct-driver activity.
acceptance: Pay only unpaid deliveries completed by the cutoff; count distinct active drivers in a clipped half-open window.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: An earlier cutoff after a later payment cannot charge again or change ledger totals.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: A completed delivery is corrected after payment. Design immutable adjustment records and idempotent refunds; explain how historical receipts and current unpaid amounts differ.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

courier-payment-ledger.invariant: Rounded delivery costs, successful payments and distinct-driver activity are different aggregates.

parts.title: Repair eligibility
parts.task: Reproduce exact completion-boundary behavior and validate job identities/durations before scheduling.
acceptance: A worker finishing now is eligible; duplicate ids and invalid durations are rejected.

parts.title: Schedule queued work
parts.task: Implement idle and busy worker management, stable arrivals, complete release and FIFO backlog handling.
acceptance: Release all eligible workers, choose the lowest idle id, and preserve stable FIFO arrival order.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Input permutation does not reorder distinct arrivals, and a backlog remains FIFO.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add job priorities without preempting active work. Define fairness/starvation policy and stable ties, then identify which queue and oracle must change.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

worker-job-dispatch.invariant: Arrival eligibility, FIFO waiting order and idle-worker selection are separate orderings.

parts.title: Restore recency
parts.task: Reproduce read-driven eviction and distinguish a cached None from a miss.
acceptance: Successful reads promote entries; a cached None is a hit.

parts.title: Resize and create safely
parts.task: Handle growth/shrink/zero capacity, same-key concurrent factories and exceptions without caching failures.
acceptance: Bounds survive resize and zero capacity; same-key creation is atomic and failed factories are not cached.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A rejected resize must preserve both the capacity and recency order used by the next eviction.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add TTL with an injected monotonic clock. Define the exact expiration boundary, whether expired reads affect recency, and how expiry interacts with atomic factories and resize.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

bounded-recency-cache.invariant: Successful reads/writes promote recency; compound creation and validation must preserve the bound.

parts.title: Repair path semantics
parts.task: Normalize roots and slash forms while distinguishing watched-path ancestry from a bare string prefix.
acceptance: Normalize root/slash forms and honor path-component boundaries.

parts.title: Propagate impact
parts.task: Handle changed files/deleted subtrees, reverse edges, cycles and unknown-service rejection.
acceptance: Deletion matches watched descendants; reverse dependency closure terminates through cycles and rejects unknown services.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Repeated normalized deletion must preserve scope boundaries; deleting root affects every watched service.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add conditional dependencies enabled by environment. Define the active graph before traversal and show how using the union of all environments would overstate impact.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

service-impact-analysis.invariant: Path ancestry uses component boundaries; dependency impact propagates from dependency to dependent.

parts.title: Validate independently
parts.task: Repair legality for selected occurrences, internal duplicates, invalid characters and empty inputs.
acceptance: Selected indices are distinct and in range; each character occurs at most once.

parts.title: Find an exact optimum
parts.task: Implement compatible-mask search with fewer-word then lexicographic ties, including duplicate occurrences.
acceptance: Maximize character count exactly, then prefer fewer words and lexicographically smaller indices.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: An exact optimum must beat a tempting overlapping word and omit useless empty words.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Give each word a value and maximize total value instead of unique character count. Show why keeping the fewest-word representative for a mask may no longer be a valid dominance rule.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

unique-word-selection.invariant: Legality differs from optimality; index identity and deterministic ties are part of the objective.

parts.title: Trust the input model
parts.task: Repair full integer fixture metadata and validate the allowed grammar, SSA ordering and arithmetic error contract.
acceptance: Full integer metadata survives loading; invalid grammar/SSA and arithmetic cases follow the stated contract.

parts.title: Measure live work
parts.task: Implement weighted arithmetic costs and alias-aware temporary liveness under allocation-before-release semantics.
acceptance: Costs reflect live arithmetic and aliases share storage; allocate results before freeing last-use operands.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Dead-code removal must reduce cost while preserving the alias-aware allocation peak of live work.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Introduce an operation with an observable side effect. Explain why backward reachability from res alone no longer justifies removing that operation and what the optimizer must preserve.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

expression-cost-analysis.invariant: Fixture truth, storage identity, allocation timing and dataflow reachability are separate concerns.

parts.title: Repair interval boundaries
parts.task: Distinguish touching half-open intervals from overlap and validate duration/window inputs.
acceptance: Touching intervals do not overlap; invalid durations/windows preserve the calendar.

parts.title: Find and reserve a gap
parts.task: Handle nested bookings, earliest exact fits, bounded windows, input copies and concurrent insertion.
acceptance: Return the earliest bounded gap in the booking union; find and insertion are one atomic reservation.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: An unavailable reservation leaves the calendar intact; a later exact adjacent slot remains bookable.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add cancellation and rescheduling by reservation id. Define which reservation is released and ensure a failed reschedule restores the original slot atomically.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

room-reservation-scheduler.invariant: A calendar is an interval union; find and insert form one atomic reservation.

parts.title: Repair event eligibility
parts.task: Verify exact thresholds, unknown-level rejection, clock injection and suppressed-event behavior.
acceptance: Thresholds are inclusive; unknown policies are rejected before writes and filtered events produce no records.

parts.title: Deliver isolated records
parts.task: Continue after failed sinks and separate caller-owned context and per-sink nested data.
acceptance: Each sink receives copied nested data; failures are reported by index without stopping later sinks.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Rejected configuration must preserve the prior policy; filtered events must not invoke the clock or sinks.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Allow asynchronous sinks. Specify backpressure, timeout/cancellation and failure reporting before adapting emit; a rejected promise must not be mistaken for successful delivery.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

structured-event-logger.invariant: Threshold inclusion, sink isolation and configuration replacement each have their own failure boundary.

parts.title: Parse valid identities
parts.task: Repair multi-character ranks and reject invalid or repeated physical cards.
acceptance: Parse the entire rank token; reject repeated physical cards and invalid rule orders.

parts.title: Compare under supplied rules
parts.task: Implement complete category/tie keys, neutral suits and an explicit category-order permutation.
acceptance: Category, pair kicker and descending rank keys determine -1/0/1; suits do not break ties.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: Category dominance must remain antisymmetric and transitive even when the weaker category has larger ranks.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Accept partial hands. Specify how incomplete categories compare with complete hands before coding; do not import five-card poker semantics or invent suit tie-breaks.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

extensible-hand-comparison.invariant: Physical identity validates hands; category precedence and rank keys determine comparison.

parts.title: Repair occupancy boundaries
parts.task: Validate touching closure/flight boundaries and distinguish a delayed start from overlap.
acceptance: Occupancy may end at closure start and never overlaps a closed interval.

parts.title: Schedule eligible flights
parts.task: Implement deterministic emergency/landing/takeoff priority, non-preemption and reselection after closures.
acceptance: Only arrived flights compete; deterministic priority does not preempt active occupancy, and closures trigger reselection.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A cancellation that arrives while the runway is closed must be applied before selecting the delayed flight.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add a second runway with its own closures and eligible flight types. Define assignment and tie policy jointly; duplicating a one-runway queue can violate global readiness and exclusion.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

runway-event-scheduler.invariant: Ready-set eligibility precedes priority; active occupancy is non-preemptive and half-open.

parts.title: Repair all-or-nothing writes
parts.task: Reproduce both injected failure points and verify balances and receipts roll back together.
acceptance: Both failure hooks roll back debit, credit and receipt together.

parts.title: Make retries and concurrency durable
parts.task: Return immutable stored replay results, reject payload conflicts and prevent overdrafts across independent connections.
acceptance: Successful receipts replay the original result; payload reuse conflicts and independent concurrent debits cannot overdraw.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A rolled-back receipt must not reserve its id or payload; the later successful payload becomes durable.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add partial refunds referencing an original transfer. Enforce a cumulative refund cap, recipient direction and independent refund idempotency within one transaction.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

transactional-wallet-transfer.invariant: Balance validation, debit, credit and payload-bound successful receipt share one durable transaction.

manual_requirements: React rendered selection, dragging, history and save/reload

parts.title: Repair movement
parts.task: Render and select shapes, convert screen movement through zoom and leave every unselected shape unchanged.
acceptance: Rendered selected-shape movement uses screen delta divided by zoom; unselected shapes stay fixed.

parts.title: Load and edit a document
parts.task: Validate JSON before replacement; preserve styles, selection and dimensions through save/load, delete and completed-action history.
acceptance: Validated load preserves rejected state; save/load, deletion and one-entry completed-drag history agree with rendering.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: A new committed edit after undo must discard the abandoned redo branch.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: Add multi-selection and group dragging. Define one group history action, selection persistence and deletion rules; show how a single selected-id model must change.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

canvas-document-editor.invariant: The document owns identity and coordinates; pointer previews are distinct from committed history.

manual_requirements: React URL hydration, direct detail/404 and stale-response behavior

parts.title: Repair query semantics
parts.task: Combine all filters, decode literals once and reject invalid pages before serving results.
acceptance: All filters combine before paging; literals decode once and invalid numeric queries return 400.

parts.title: Integrate browser routes
parts.task: Hydrate refresh/back state, reset pages, serve direct detail routes and retain latest-request loading/error/result ownership.
acceptance: URL state hydrates refresh/back, detail/404 routes work, and stale responses cannot own current rows/errors/loading.

parts.title: Pressure-test the model
parts.task: Run the added fixture, then construct a second input exposing the same incorrect assumption. Explain the expected outcome before accepting a proposed AI repair.
acceptance: All three filters must compose before sort, total and page selection at the HTTP boundary.

parts.title: Changed requirement — optional discussion
parts.task: The catalogue changes between pages. Compare snapshot tokens or cursor pagination with numeric offsets; define ordering and URL behavior before promising stable traversal.
acceptance: Identify the changed invariant, affected code/data, and a minimal counterexample before proposing an implementation.

movie-search-routing.invariant: The URL is canonical view state; filter/sort/count/page order and request identity must agree across browser and API.
